<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!--
  ESS control panel. Addresses from app_modbus_map.c writeRegData (43001 = 3000).
  3000 = PCS command (MF_PCS_Command), 3002 = test command (MF_TestCmd, test mode 1/2),
  3006 = GC/IS mode, 3064/3065 = remote P/Q reference (raw, no clamp on this path).
-->
<controls>
  <group title="PCS Command">
    <cmd label="System ON"   addr="3000" value="1" color="success"/>
    <cmd label="System OFF"  addr="3000" value="2" color="warning" confirm="true"/>
    <cmd label="Fault Reset" addr="3000" value="3"/>
    <cmd label="Start"       addr="3000" value="11" color="success"/>
    <cmd label="Start OFF"   addr="3000" value="12"/>
    <cmd label="Reboot"      addr="3000" value="8" color="danger" confirm="true"/>
  </group>
  <group title="PWM / Derating">
    <cmd label="PWM ON"       addr="3000" value="13"/>
    <cmd label="PWM OFF"      addr="3000" value="14" confirm="true"/>
    <cmd label="Derating ON"  addr="3000" value="90"/>
    <cmd label="Derating OFF" addr="3000" value="91"/>
  </group>
  <group title="Control Mode">
    <cmd label="GC Mode"      addr="3006" value="0"/>
    <cmd label="IS Mode"      addr="3006" value="1" confirm="true"/>
    <cmd label="AUTO IS Mode" addr="3006" value="2" confirm="true"/>
  </group>
  <group title="Remote References">
    <!-- raw int16 written as-is (BATT_REMOTE_PCC_P_REF/Q_REF); unit follows the param scale -->
    <input label="Remote P Ref (raw)" addr="3064" min="-32768" max="32767" scale="1" decimals="0" signed="true" valueType="int16" default="0" confirm="true"/>
    <input label="Remote Q Ref (raw)" addr="3065" min="-32768" max="32767" scale="1" decimals="0" signed="true" valueType="int16" default="0" confirm="true"/>
  </group>
  <group title="Test Mode">
    <cmd label="Test Mode ON (STOP/FAULT)" addr="3000" value="9" color="warning" confirm="true"/>
    <cmd label="Test Mode OFF"  addr="3000" value="10"/>
    <cmd label="Test: CB1A ON"  addr="3002" value="1" confirm="true"/>
    <cmd label="Test: CB1A OFF" addr="3002" value="2"/>
    <cmd label="Test: CB1 ON"   addr="3002" value="3" confirm="true"/>
    <cmd label="Test: CB1 OFF"  addr="3002" value="4"/>
    <cmd label="Test: CB2 ON"   addr="3002" value="11" confirm="true"/>
    <cmd label="Test: CB2 OFF"  addr="3002" value="12"/>
    <cmd label="Test Run ON"    addr="3002" value="15" confirm="true"/>
    <cmd label="Test Run OFF"   addr="3002" value="16"/>
  </group>
  <group title="Trace Capture">
    <cmd label="Trace Stop"    addr="3000" value="6"/>
    <cmd label="Trace Restart" addr="3000" value="7" color="success"/>
  </group>
  <group title="Maintenance (CTRL_TEST_MODE = 5 only)">
    <cmd label="Param Factory Reset + Reboot" addr="3000" value="4" color="danger" confirm="true"/>
    <cmd label="History Clear" addr="3000" value="5" color="danger" confirm="true"/>
  </group>
</controls>
